title: The world’s money
slide_intent: Reduce a brand promise to a memorable phrase so people can understand the intended reach before seeing detailed features.
strategic_value: A short global promise in Wise’s heavy lettering can give varied services a common idea.
demonstration: Dark green uppercase words form two centered lines on white: The World’s above Money.
practical_value: Assess whether a central positioning phrase is concise enough to lead diverse communications.

content_islands.spec: Center the two-line promise on a plain white field, keeping the second line shorter.
